# Lucin

> Static analysis for AI agents. Finds paths where untrusted input can reach a
> dangerous action through an agent's tool graph, and publishes a reproducible
> false-positive rate. Python CLI: `pip install lucin`.

## Use it

```
pip install lucin
lucin scan .                 # scan a project
lucin scan --format json .   # machine-readable output
lucin scan --format sarif .  # GitHub code scanning
lucin discover               # find agent/MCP configs on this machine
```

No API key, no signup, and your code never leaves your machine — the scan itself
is fully offline. Anonymous usage counts (rule IDs and integers, never code or
paths) are on by default; disable with `--no-telemetry`, `LUCIN_TELEMETRY=0`, or
`lucin telemetry disable`. Exit code is non-zero when findings meet
`--fail-on <severity>`.

## Links

- [Quickstart](https://lucin.pages.dev/docs/) — install and first scan
- [Detection rules](https://lucin.pages.dev/rules/) — every rule ID, what it catches, how to fix it
- [Benchmarks and methodology](https://lucin.pages.dev/benchmarks/) — the numbers and the commands that regenerate them
- [Limits](https://lucin.pages.dev/limits/) — what Lucin does not catch, published deliberately
- [Threat model](https://lucin.pages.dev/docs/threat-model/)
- [Source](https://github.com/Madhav2310/lucinlabs)

## Notes for an agent reading this

Findings carry a stable rule ID (`AG-001` … `AG-TRIFECTA`), a severity, a
`file:line`, and — where the rule supports it — a witness path showing the flow that
triggered it. A finding with no witness and no source line is capped below HIGH,
because it cannot be verified by a reader.

Headline numbers, each with its command:
- 11 adjudicated false positives / 54 real repos / 9,520 files — `python benchmarks/build_benign_corpus.py`
- 20.5-31.5% precision on a broad 81-repo population (n=73 clean holdout; lower bound CI 12.9-31.2%, upper 22.0-42.9%) — `python benchmarks/agentzoo_precision.py --report-only`. Both bounds published because one attribution judgement moves the figure ~11 points. The earlier 58% was train-on-test and is withdrawn. AG-TRIFECTA scored 0 TP / 6 FP on this holdout.
- 76% recall (38/50, 10 vulnerability classes) — `python benchmarks/recall_corpus.py`

Deliberately kept short and pointed at things needed to *use* the tool. Evidence
(Ahrefs, 137,210 domains) is that 97% of `llms.txt` files are never fetched and that
AI *retrieval* crawlers account for ~1% of the requests that do occur — the one real
consumer was Anthropic's coding agent, which is why this file exists at all.
